name: Vsjo, chto pohoroneno pod snegom
source:
Outside the window of the tiny room, an endless blizzard rages. What kind of person can survive in such conditions? Obviously, only a man hiding in this tiny room. Preserving the knowledge and memories of everyone who didn't fit in that room.

[Translated from [url=https://dn0l.itch.io/sneg]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
狭小的房间的窗外，漫无边际的暴风雪肆虐着。什么样的人能够在这样的条件下生存呢？显然，这个狭小的房间里只藏着一个人。保存每个不适合这个房间的人的知识和记忆。

[译自[url=https://dn0l.itch.io/sneg]Itch.io[/url]]
